presets.name: Papers (NegPy)/Neutral (default)
presets.description: NegPy's neutral paper: Print Response back to its defaults (nothing added).

presets.name: Papers (NegPy)/B&W/Ilford Multigrade RC
presets.description: A neutral variable-contrast workhorse on resin-coated paper: maximum density about 2.1, normal contrast. Ported from NegPy's paper profile (GPL-3.0) by fitting Print Response's five sliders to its curve: the fit is within 0.25 of 255 tone levels, and the paper itself differs from neutral by 3.1. Only the tone curve is carried over: NegPy's colour terms for this paper and its lith colour path are not part of Print Response.
